deterministic.summary: HV loss was the BMS under-voltage protection acting (protective response, not the origin). Open upstream explanations: SOC estimation / calibration error; Usable capacity far below the stated parameter; Current under-measured or load bypassing the sensor. The recorded data does not separate them. A weak cell cannot explain the whole incident on its own: the highest cell was also depleted (pack-wide decline larger than the cell spread), and the SOC accounting discrepancy is pack-level: a weak cell can be an additional contributor, not the whole explanation. No root cause is confirmed.

result.explanation: HV loss was the BMS under-voltage protection. Upstream, SOC overstatement, far lower usable capacity, or under-measured current all fit; recorded signals cannot separate them. A weak cell alone does not explain it.

evidence.quote: CHANGE battery.soc[bms] at t=1597 s: 43.2 -> 27.2 % (step -16, 10x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: SOC re-stated by tens of points while current stayed 6.54 A; 37.95 pp unexplained by measured charge (0.0545 Ah).

evidence.quote: CONSTANT battery.pack_current held 6.54 from t=0 to 2100 s (4201 samples)
evidence.shows: Measured current is flat, so counted charge is small (about 3.8 Ah total) against a stated 100 Ah.

evidence.quote: SHIFT battery.cell_voltage[min] changed level for good at t=640 s: median 3.2 before, 2.864 after V (2240x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Cell voltages fell early (t=640 s), long before the SOC correction. The highest cell fell as well (line 23), so the decline is pack-wide.
Fault level 3 and both contactors opening occur together at 2100.5 s, after levels 1 (t=1453) and 2 (t=1799): a protective response.

checked.check: Charge accounting: SOC against measured charge
checked.result: SOC tracked measured charge / about 91-112 Ah between corrections, then one 60.8 -> 22.8 % step in 30 s that measured charge explains by only 0.054 pp.
About 3.8 Ah delivered to cutoff against 63.6 Ah promised; needs SOC overstated ~60 pp, or capacity ~6 Ah, or current under-read ~16.7x.
checked.about: SOC error vs capacity vs current sensing

checked.check: Sequence and compare at the cell-voltage shift (t=640 s) and the SOC step (t=1597 s)
checked.result: No other signal left baseline first at 600-700 s. At 1597 s only SOC changed sharply, and current did not change.

checked.check: Weak cell: pack-wide decline against cell spread
checked.result: Highest cell fell 450 mV, more than the 260 mV spread at trip; lowest cell was index 64 in 100% of samples.

effects.why: Contactor opening is the BMS protective response at fault level 3, not the origin.
Same protective response; HV lost as a consequence of cell under-voltage.

effects.why: Current goes to zero as the pack is cut off. The recording does not show who commanded it.
